BEFORE assembling the"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" system prompt, and `inbox.claim()` emits the

fir"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"st request is classified instead of unconditionally falling into weak.

`session/event` ne"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"ver fires inside agent-plane presets (dsh-scope filters
it out of entry-local realms), so the old in"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"box re-append never delivered
guidance — and wherever it did fire, the `next-step` append forced a S"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"never delivered
guidance — and wherever it did fire, the `next-step` append forced a SECOND
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"**router-standard**: reads the session's first REAL user message, classifies
the task (build → react"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" / fix → spec / ambiguous → weak), and on the first
model request injects the matching persona while"},{"id":"p15s3","text":" keeping the full prompt
sections; the first-turn core tool surface follows the band
(spec=read/edit"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"/glob/grep, react=read/write/edit, weak=read/write/edit, each
plus the platform shell). Weak-band se"},{"id":"p15s5","text":"ssions also get a near-field routing
guide in the SAME request as every real user message."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"**router-spec**: same routing core with the deep-think-first branding; keeps
the v0.2.0 dual-mode co"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"de path (`routerMode`), so a copy configured with
`routerMode: standard` still gets the RL-interface"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" first turn (RL sentence +
shell/str_replace_editor) with full sections restored after the first dur"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" sentence +
shell/str_replace_editor) with full sections restored after the first durable
tool/call."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"After the first durable tool call the full Standard catalog is exposed and the
router stops touching"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" anything. The mode is derived from durable session
events, so resume/reload keeps it. The plan-mode"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" prompt section is preserved,
so plan boundaries do not reset the model's focus."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Why: dual-attractor RL policy"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Evidence across projects (see `docs/paper.md` and `docs/experiments.md`):"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- The **same model** reaches top-band scores under spec conditions on a
maintenance benchmark (Proje"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ct2: minimal 99/96, anchored 98/99) and under
react/code conditions on a greenfield build task (Mari"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"o: 10/10), while the
wrong mode scores 91 / 6 respectively — a ~10-point swing from prompt
condition"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"ing alone ("god/ghost duality").
- Persona is the dominant trigger (one-sentence swap flips the traj"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"ectory);
tool-schema surface is a secondary condition; catalog text in a user message
has no effect."},{"id":"p20s6","text":"
- Behavior is path-committed: once anchored, expanding the tool catalog
perturbs at most one reason"},{"id":"p20s7","text":"ing block and never flips the mode.
- Intermediate personas are **out-of-distribution** (training-di"},{"id":"p20s8","text":"stribution
gap), which is the measured unstable band."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The model cannot self-route: P3 (same persona, task swap → trajectory
unchanged), P5 (router persona"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"s → doer attractor absorbs the instruction) and
P8 (domain-overlap scan) show the only internal-rout"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"ing window is a WEAK
persona + few-shot routing instruction (lean, not flip; discrimination
+2.3..+3"},{"id":"p21s4","text":".3). There is no reward signal for switching modes mid session, and
the behavior phase transition me"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"ans the model commits on the first request.
**Mode selection must come from outside** — a human (the"},{"id":"p21s6","text":" "streamer"), a
heuristic classifier, or a learned router. This preset is the automated
version of t"},{"id":"p21s7","text":"hat external routing."}],"truncated":true}
